notes.title: Update 1.2.0.8
notes.content:
[b]Added reflex rounds.[/b]

There will be some balance checks for these done soon. Have already played them for hours.

[b]Boss enemies buffed. Some changes to boss AI[/b]
More likely to block your attacks. HP increased to better scale with the player.

[b]Crow Enemy[/b]
No longer as aggressive as it was. Might peck at you while on the ground though!


Stat menu tells you what button to press for confirming stats and added a visual confirmation so you know it worked.

Audio - Different music now plays during the "reflex round"

Level design - I did spend some time making the levels look a little better. I like the changes and hope you will too.

notes.title: Update 1.1.9.8
notes.content:
Bug fix - Removed a visible trigger.

Arcade mode - Decreased player start HP - Found it a little too easy.

Survival mode - Score doubled.

Player Level - Player level now maxed at 10. Can no longer max all skills, making your choices matter.

Max Level now displayed in GUI when the player hits level 10.

Controls - ESC key at the main menu now exits the game.
